exactOriginalText: TU4-05-A: A recorded 200-cubic-foot quantity is redirected ten feet from an open basin into a real adjacent channel with sufficient volume. The basin loses that exact quantity and the channel receives it once. Releasing concentration leaves it in the channel under ordinary flow; neither the basin nor abstract Supply is refilled.

TU4-05-B: An unwilling swimmer in the selected water fails STR and moves ten feet along a legal open path. A second paid control Action that numbered round cannot force another displacement attempt on that same creature. A moored boat in the water does not break its real tether merely because the caster declared Redirect.

TU4-06-A: A synthetic admitted mundane recipe has Q4, DC12, forty pounds of real stock and four eight-pound Standard outputs, with adequate packaging and otherwise valid tools/formula. A total of 12 makes four finished units during the one casting Action; eight pounds remain recorded as the actual recipe waste. No ordinary eight-hour work period is fabricated and no trade XP is awarded by this proposal.

TU4-06-B: A source Enchanting order needs an admitted ordinary sword body plus actual magical process inputs and imbuement work. Fabricate cannot finish that magical order. A separate eligible mundane sword recipe can supply a real ordinary sword from its own complete raw materials, after which the actual Enchanting order still needs all of its own inputs, work and source permissions.

TR5-01-A: An eligible20cubic-foot sand patch inside the full60-foot-radius area becomes20cubic feet of ice. The reference input2000lb becomes1140lb output under the explicit transmutation exception. There is one transformed lot, not both sand and ice; melting it later creates no second parallel stock entry or guaranteed clean-water certificate.

TR5-01-B: Swamp-to-stone affects only the eligible top foot and leaves living roots, creatures and a built bridge untouched. A creature's occupied body is not filled with stone. The spell does not mine the new rock, supply a finished masonry item or let a merchant buy the same old mud and transformed stone separately.

TR5-04-A: An800lb total Large armored creature and a150lb Medium ally in metal armor both lie in the sphere. Each actual unwilling subject makes STR; a failed result moves that whole subject up to20feet toward center, stopping at blockers. Two metal armor pieces on the same ally do not cause two saves or40feet of movement.

TR5-04-B: An unattended metal breastplate is pulled without a save, but a coin purse alone does not qualify its unarmored carrier. A1400lb metal body exceeds the explicit new cap and is not moved. A failed pull against a rigid fixed anchor neither tears off the armor nor manufactures crushing damage.

TR5-06-A: A declared tunnel crosses a12-foot ordinary stone wall and opens to a real empty corridor. Creatures walk through the actual opening using real movement. An unknown25-foot thickness would instead defeat the paid formation; the spell supplies neither a portal nor an exact wall-thickness scan.

TR5-06-B: At closure a creature stands near one mouth. The closest reachable legal adjacent exterior space receives its whole body and carried gear by the bounded ejection. If both mouths are blocked, a recorded local conflict preserves that one body until legal removal; no arbitrary burial damage, duplicate gear or search for a distant safe room is allowed.

TR5-08-A: A real10cubic-foot mud lot becomes10cubic feet of ordinary stone: reference mass700→1500lb under the explicit conversion exception. The owner must still excavate/transport the actual1500lb and cannot sell the old700lb mud separately. No gem,source-tier upgrade,perfect brick wall or automatic crafting success is created.

TR5-08-B: An eligible unsupported ceiling section becomes mud and its bounded burst rolls15bludgeoning. An affected creature saving takes7before other defenses, once for that converted falling mass. A different occupied muddy region hardened to stone leaves actual creature clearance rather than petrifying its occupants. Previously damaged solid stock does not return at fullHP merely through mud and back.

TU6-04-A: A complete30-by20-by20-foot timber building and its actual occupants/contents weigh80000lb. Its disconnected fittings,clear swept space and compatible supported destination permit a20-foot horizontal move. The same furniture,people and damaged roof arrive once;neither new loot nor repaired timbers appear. An occupant at a reachable exterior edge may use the proposed successful-DEX5-foot escape.

TU6-04-B: A corner20feet from the chosen rotation axis would travel about31.416feet in a90-degree rotation,exceeding the30-foot point-path limit even though90degrees is the nominal angular maximum. That declared move is ineligible;choose a smaller legal rotation before casting. A destination over an unsupported pit is likewise not a legal way to use the spell for automatic building-scale crushing damage.

TU6-06-A: The caster moves an actual10-by10-by10-foot block-equivalent of loose earth,1000cubic feet,into a legal nearby berm inside the40-foot cube. The excavation and berm contain the same material. A200-cubic-foot existing cavity cannot receive all1000without another legal receiving volume;the extra800cannot vanish or become compressed commodity stone.

TU6-06-B: An occupant on affected ground fails DEX,rides the actual legal ground displacement and becomes Prone. If the plan instead removes support,it faces real falling from its actual height,not a separate invented6d6spell attack. A concealed immovable object preventing the declared conserved transition can cause paid failure without disclosing a secret tunnel map or deleting that object.
